literal: Even if they do not have fortress goodness and greatness, to oppose adversaries with their dwelling land is difficult.
translation: Even if adversaries lack strong fortresses and great resources, it is difficult to defeat them when they are in their own home territory.
modern: அரண் வலிமையும் சிறப்பும் இல்லாதவர்களாக இருந்தாலும், பகைவர்கள் வாழ்கின்ற சொந்த நிலத்திற்குச் சென்று அவர்களை வெல்வது கடினம்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the strategic advantage of home territory in conflict. Even if adversaries do not possess strong defensive fortifications or great resources, they retain a natural strength by being in their own familiar dwelling place. Attempting to attack or conquer them on their own ground is extremely difficult. A wise leader must therefore respect the power of location and avoid engaging enemies in their home territory.
